Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation defines and displays the healthcare services that it provides.
Official Title (4th Ed): The organisation defines and displays the healthcare services that it can provide.
Exact Requirement Summary: Hospital defines clinical services, tariffs, scope, and services not provided.

Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation has a well-defined registration and admission process.
Official Title (4th Ed): The organisation has a well-defined registration and admission process.
Exact Requirement Summary: Unique permanent UHID assigned; standardized admission; bed allocation.

Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): Patients cared for by the organisation undergo an established initial assessment.
Official Title (4th Ed): Patients cared for by the organisation undergo an established initial assessment.
Exact Requirement Summary: Medical assessment <= 24h, nursing assessment on admission, MNA nutrition screening, pain scale.

Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation ensures continuity of care.
Official Title (4th Ed): The organisation ensures continuity of care.
Exact Requirement Summary: Coordinated multidisciplinary team care, daily doctor rounds, shift handover integration.

Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): Patients cared for by the organisation undergo regular reassessment.
Official Title (4th Ed): Patients cared for by the organisation undergo regular reassessment.
Exact Requirement Summary: Regular clinical reassessment, vital sign trending, pain reassessment within 30-60 mins of intervention.

Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation defines a safe process for transfer and referral of patients.
Official Title (4th Ed): There is an appropriate mechanism for transfer or referral of patients.
Exact Requirement Summary: Standardized SBAR transfer format, clinical summary, transfer vitals, staff escort, ambulance check.

Chapter Name: Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care
Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation has a defined process for discharge of patients.
Official Title (4th Ed): The discharge process is planned and organized.
Exact Requirement Summary: Formal discharge summary at discharge, diagnosis, treatment, medication reconciliation, red flags, LAMA protocol.

Official Title (5th Ed): Uniform care to patients is provided in all settings of the organisation.
Official Title (4th Ed): Uniform care and planned care delivery.
Exact Requirement Summary: Uniform care guidelines, individualized care plans, unified progress notes.

Official Title (5th Ed): Emergency services are guided by policies, procedures, applicable laws and regulations.
Exact Requirement Summary: Triage protocol (Red/Yellow/Green/Black), rapid survey, MLC tracking.

Official Title (5th Ed): Ambulance services ensure safe patient transportation with appropriate care.
Exact Requirement Summary: Equipped BLS/ACLS ambulances, emergency drugs, trained EMT personnel.

Official Title (5th Ed): Cardio-pulmonary resuscitation services are provided uniformly across the organisation.
Exact Requirement Summary: Code Blue announcement, resuscitation team response < 3 mins, crash cart audit.

Official Title (5th Ed): Nursing care is provided to patients in consonance with clinical protocols.
Exact Requirement Summary: Shift vitals, 24h intake/output balance, nursing care plan, eMAR dual check.

Official Title (5th Ed): Clinical procedures are performed in a safe manner.
Exact Requirement Summary: Informed procedural consent, universal identification, aseptic prep, post-procedure monitor.

Official Title (5th Ed): Transfusion services are managed safely as per defined scope.
Exact Requirement Summary: Cross-match check, bedside 2-person verification, hemovigilance reaction tracking.

Official Title (5th Ed): Intensive care and high dependency units follow structured guidelines.
Exact Requirement Summary: Nurse-patient ratio 1:1 or 1:2, hourly hemodynamics, ventilator parameters, ABG.

Official Title (5th Ed): Anaesthesia services are provided in a consistent and safe manner.
Exact Requirement Summary: Pre-anaesthesia evaluation, pre-induction review, intra-op EtCO2 monitoring, Aldrete discharge score.

Official Title (5th Ed): Surgical services are provided in a consistent and safe manner.
Exact Requirement Summary: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist (Sign In, Time Out, Sign Out), operative notes before recovery transfer.

Official Title (5th Ed): Pharmacy services and medication management are guided by policies.
Exact Requirement Summary: Formulary management, storage, cold chain 2-8 C, medication reconciliation.

Official Title (5th Ed): Policies and procedures guide the administration of medications.
Exact Requirement Summary: 5 Rights verification, eMAR documentation, dual verification of high-alert drugs.

Official Title (5th Ed): Patient and family education is provided to empower them in decision making.
Exact Requirement Summary: Learning barriers assessment, multidisciplinary education (ASH/COU/1), return demonstration.

Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation has a mechanism to address patient and family complaints and grievances.
Exact Requirement Summary: Grievance logging, investigation, root cause, CAPA, resolution turnaround time.

Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation implements the infection prevention and control programme in all areas.
Exact Requirement Summary: WHO 5 Moments Hand Hygiene compliance, point-of-care sanitizer, disinfectant contact time.

Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation performs surveillance of healthcare-associated infections.
Exact Requirement Summary: Surveillance of CAUTI, CLABSI, VAP, SSI; daily device days; bundle care checklists.

Official Title (5th Ed): Biomedical waste is managed in accordance with statutory rules.
Exact Requirement Summary: 4-color segregation (Yellow, Red, White, Blue), barcoding, daily weight logs, CBWTF manifest.

Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation implements a clinical safety program.
Exact Requirement Summary: Morse Fall scale, Braden pressure ulcer scale, Caprini VTE scale, near-miss logging.

Official Title (5th Ed): Clinical and managerial key performance indicators are monitored and analysed.
Exact Requirement Summary: Monitoring of all 49 NABH quality indicators with monthly review and benchmarking.

Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation has processes in place for effective medical records management.
Exact Requirement Summary: Single composite chart, author identification, timestamps, chart completeness audit.

Official Title (5th Ed): The organisation maintains confidentiality, integrity and security of information.
Exact Requirement Summary: Role-based access control, password policy, electronic audit trails for edit/view/delete.
